SELECT t.areaCode,sum(t.device_count) as deviceCount FROM ( (SELECT
province_id as areaCode,
city_id as areaCode,
county_id as areaCode,
county_id as areaCode,
COUNT(*) as device_count FROM vm_iot_device_t WHERE delete_flag = 0
GROUP BY areaCode ) union ( select
province_id as areaCode,
city_id as areaCode,
county_id as areaCode,
county_id as areaCode,
COUNT(*) as device_count from vm_device_info_t where delete_flag ='0'
AND device_code in
#{item}
AND 1 = 0
GROUP BY areaCode ) ) t GROUP BY t.areaCode ORDER BY deviceCount DESC limit 5

SELECT t.areaCode as areaCode, t.deviceType as deviceType, t.device_count as deviceCount FROM ( ( SELECT
province_id as areaCode,
city_id as areaCode,
county_id as areaCode,
county_id as areaCode,
case when category_code=1 and device_type=400600020003 then 2 when category_code=2 and device_type=40084401 then 1 when category_code=2 and device_type=40084403 then 4 when category_code=2 and device_type=40084402 then 5 else null end as deviceType, COUNT(*) as device_count FROM vm_iot_device_t WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND( ( category_code=2 and device_type in
#{item} ) or (category_code=1 and device_type=400600020003) )
AND device_code in
#{item}
AND 1 = 0
AND province_id in
AND city_id in
AND county_id in
AND county_id in
#{item}
GROUP BY areaCode,deviceType ) union ( SELECT
province_id as areaCode,
city_id as areaCode,
county_id as areaCode,
county_id as areaCode,
3 as deviceType, COUNT(*) as device_count FROM vm_device_info_t WHERE delete_flag = 0
AND device_code in
#{item}
AND 1 = 0
AND province_id in
AND city_id in
AND county_id in
AND county_id in
#{item}
GROUP BY areaCode ) ) t ORDER BY t.device_count DESC

select AREA_CODE as areaCode,AREA_NAME as areaName from sys_area where AREA_CODE in
#{areaCode}
